newsitem.title: USA: Rumors say India bought 1 mln T Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Rumors say India bought 1 mln T Australian wheat.

text.p: Talk was widespread in U.S. grain export markets early Thursday that India bought one million tonnes of Australian wheat overnight, U.S. exporters said.
The exporters said they were awaiting confirmation of the deal. The talk suggested the wheat was largely for January shipment.
U.S. exporters said the deal would not be surprising because there was talk of an Indian wheat tender late Wednesday.
"We thought if it got done, it would be Australian," said one exporter, who was aware of the tender talk but could not confirm the deal was completed.

Exporters said India also is scheduled to tender December 16 for wheat for late January arrival. A few exporters said India seeks 500,000 tonnes in that tender, while others said India did not specify a quantity.
Exporters doubt India will buy a large amount of U.S. wheat because it is not price competitive with other origins.
"If it is U.S. (wheat), the only class would be soft white," said one exporter.
India's food minister said early Thursday that India would import two million tonnes of wheat by March to augment domestic supplies.
